meta.source: Stitch export stitch_ohmytoys; one design for every platform, drawn by MyGo; desktop-only parts designed

tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: Window content area: the workbench behind every page. Opaque on both platforms.

tokens.name: bg-titlebar
tokens.usage: The 48pt titlebar strip. Opaque. The OS draws its window controls over it, in the room c.TitleBar() reports.

tokens.name: bg-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar when the window has no material (transparency turned off, or a platform without one).

tokens.name: bg-sidebar-material
tokens.usage: Sidebar tint over the window material (mygo.WindowOptions.Vibrancy: sidebar vibrancy on macOS, Mica on Windows). Designed for the desktop app.

tokens.name: bg-card
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, settings groups, tables. Dark cards are a 5% white layer over bg-canvas.

tokens.name: bg-selected
tokens.usage: The selected sidebar row: a raised pill.

tokens.name: bg-button
tokens.usage: Secondary button, Select and Kbd fill.

tokens.name: bg-popover
tokens.usage: Tray panel, command palette, dialogs, tooltips, when no material is available. Dark value is the source's surface-container.

tokens.name: bg-popover-material
tokens.usage: Tint over the popover material of the tray panel and command palette. Designed for the desktop app.

tokens.name: fill-control
tokens.usage: Rest fill of search, text fields, segmented tracks, ghost buttons, neutral badges.

tokens.name: fill-control-hover
tokens.usage: Pointer over a control or row.

tokens.name: fill-control-pressed
tokens.usage: Mouse button held down on a control or row. Designed for the desktop app; the reference screens do not show it.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the window content behind a modal dialog. Designed for the desktop app; the reference screens do not show it.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: Selected text in fields and copyable values, as the reference screens set it.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers, card borders, titlebar bottom edge, sidebar right edge.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of chips, secondary buttons, Select, Kbd, popovers.

tokens.name: line-hairline
tokens.usage: Faintest rims and row separators: selected nav pill, segmented track, table rows.

tokens.name: line-hover
tokens.usage: Card and checkbox border under the pointer.

tokens.name: text-strong
tokens.usage: Headings, the app name, the selected nav label, data values, on bg-canvas, bg-card and bg-popover.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Body copy and row titles on any surface.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Descriptions, badge text, middle breadcrumbs, on any surface.

tokens.name: text-inactive
tokens.usage: Unselected sidebar rows, segments and chips; page descriptions. 5.8:1 on light bg-canvas, 5.2:1 on dark bg-card.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Placeholders, mono hints, separators, the titlebar text of an inactive window. Light is 3.15:1 on bg-canvas and 2.92:1 on bg-sidebar, below 4.5:1 and kept exact from the source: never the only copy of a label.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Primary button and active filter chip fill.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on inverse.

tokens.name: thumb
tokens.usage: Selected segment of a segmented control.

tokens.name: on-thumb
tokens.usage: Label on thumb.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: selected nav glyph and dot, panel title glyphs, text links. Fixed brand value, it does not follow the system accent colour. Turns text-muted while the window is inactive.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Selection borders, switch and checkbox fills, keyboard focus ring (3.6:1 on light bg-canvas).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Text on accent-soft: Active badges, the highlighted row's hint in the palette.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Accent badge fill; the highlighted row in the command palette and tray panel.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Accent badge border.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Passing or positive values. Light on success-soft is 2.79:1, kept exact from the source: always with a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success badge fill.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: Running dots: helper process, Keep Awake, auto-refresh.

tokens.name: live-text
tokens.usage: Running label next to a live dot. Light is 3.77:1 on white: bold mono only.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Conflicts in a rename preview, notices.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a conflicting row in a ResultList. Designed for the desktop app; the reference screens do not show it.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive text and the solid destructive button in dialogs.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on a solid danger button. Designed for the desktop app; the reference screens do not show it.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of tinted danger buttons (Kill). Dark from the source; light follows the 10% rule of accent-soft.

tokens.name: danger-line
tokens.usage: Border of tinted danger buttons.

tokens.name: icon-tile
tokens.usage: Tool icon tile, top of its vertical gradient (sampled from the tool icon art).

tokens.name: icon-tile-end
tokens.usage: Tool icon tile, bottom of the gradient.

tokens.name: icon-ink
tokens.usage: The single ink of a tool glyph on icon-tile.

tokens.name: sandbox-bg
tokens.usage: Fixed-dark preview dock in the theme gallery. Same in both app themes: it shows a terminal palette, not the app theme.

tokens.name: sandbox-tile
tokens.usage: Tiles inside the sandbox.

tokens.name: sandbox-line
tokens.usage: Tile rims inside the sandbox.

tokens.name: sandbox-text
tokens.usage: Body text on sandbox-tile (6.9:1).

tokens.name: sandbox-muted
tokens.usage: Metadata on sandbox-tile (4.6:1).

tokens.name: sandbox-blue
tokens.usage: Sandbox accent; progress start.

tokens.name: sandbox-purple
tokens.usage: Second sandbox accent; progress end.

tokens.name: sandbox-cyan
tokens.usage: Third sandbox accent: ports, hashes.

tokens.name: sandbox-green
tokens.usage: Live dot inside the sandbox.

tokens.name: cat-system
tokens.usage: System category: glyph and label colour on cat-system-soft. Light from the source; dark is the same hue one step lighter on a 20% fill.

tokens.name: cat-system-soft
tokens.usage: System category tile and badge fill.

tokens.name: cat-file
tokens.usage: Files category: glyph and label colour on cat-file-soft. Light from the source; dark is the same hue one step lighter on a 20% fill.

tokens.name: cat-file-soft
tokens.usage: Files category tile and badge fill.

tokens.name: cat-dev
tokens.usage: Developer category: glyph and label colour on cat-dev-soft. Light from the source; dark is the same hue one step lighter on a 20% fill.

tokens.name: cat-dev-soft
tokens.usage: Developer category tile and badge fill.

tokens.name: cat-network
tokens.usage: Network category: glyph and label colour on cat-network-soft. Light from the source; dark is the same hue one step lighter on a 20% fill.

tokens.name: cat-network-soft
tokens.usage: Network category tile and badge fill.

tokens.name: cat-text
tokens.usage: Text category: glyph and label colour on cat-text-soft. Light from the source; dark is the same hue one step lighter on a 20% fill.

tokens.name: cat-text-soft
tokens.usage: Text category tile and badge fill.

tokens.name: cat-media
tokens.usage: Media category: glyph and label colour on cat-media-soft. Light from the source; dark is the same hue one step lighter on a 20% fill.

tokens.name: cat-media-soft
tokens.usage: Media category tile and badge fill.

tokens.name: cat-productivity
tokens.usage: Productivity category: glyph and label colour on cat-productivity-soft. Light from the source; dark is the same hue one step lighter on a 20% fill.

tokens.name: cat-productivity-soft
tokens.usage: Productivity category tile and badge fill.

tokens.name: cat-app
tokens.usage: App category: glyph and label colour on cat-app-soft. Light from the source; dark is the same hue one step lighter on a 20% fill.

tokens.name: cat-app-soft
tokens.usage: App category tile and badge fill.

styles.name: headline

styles.name: body

styles.name: small
styles.usage: The smallest sans size: dense helper copy only.

styles.name: palette-input
styles.usage: The command palette's query field. Designed.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section eyebrows and table headers, uppercase.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Metadata, table cells, card footers, paths.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Timers and counters, with tabular figures.
